concerns.text: The specification does not state how many short‑interval windows will be sampled per length L. The unresolved concern notes that only 20 non‑overlapping windows per length provide limited power to detect small deviations, especially after multiple‑testing correction. Without a clear sampling plan (or justification for a larger sample), the methodology may be under‑powered.

SC-003 claims the full pipeline must finish within ≤ 6 hours, yet FR-002 requires autocorrelation for *all* lags h ≤ L/2 across sliding windows. This can entail on the order of 10⁹ autocorrelation calculations, which the spec does not justify as feasible on the free‑tier GitHub Actions runner. The runtime estimate appears optimistic and lacks a concrete algorithmic optimisation plan.

FR-002 says the system MUST compute autocorrelation for all lags within sliding windows of length L, but does not define the sliding‑window step size or the total number of windows. This omission makes it impossible to verify that the implementation will respect the memory and time bounds stated in SC-003, and may lead to an unbounded computational load.
